description:
Altar is a 70ft Durreti flybridge motor yacht available for private charter in Dubai, offering a spacious interior made for entertaining, a large aft deck and a flybridge with panoramic views.

She welcomes up to 23 guests, has one cabin and is run by a professional crew of 2. Departing from Dubai Marina, she is a great choice for birthdays, family days and groups of friends, with routes past Bluewaters, Ain Dubai, the Palm Jumeirah and the Burj Al Arab.

Charters are available by the hour, for sunset cruises or for the full day. Contact Yacht Research for availability, routes and a tailored quote.
